This is before full payload utilization, reusability and manufacturing learning rates kick in, which we expect to lead to 16x cheaper launch/Tbps cost by 2028.

What can Astra do when given a humanoid embodiment? 

We built HomeBody to find out. Controlled by GPT Astra, it carries out long-horizon tasks in a previously unseen kitchen—from tidying up across the room to retrieving remembered objects from ambiguous requests—without environment-specific training data or additional policy learning.
